# Value objects

Value objects have no file of their own: each travels under `$defs` of every entity schema that embeds it, with the same content in every file. They carry no `id`, `schema_version`, `created_at` or `metadata`. Schema version `0.0.1`.

## AgentTargetRef

Embedded in: [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md), [Run](Run.md), [RunBundle](RunBundle.md)

### Description

``{id, version, content_digest?}`` of an ``AgentTarget`` (ADR 0009 Decision 4, N35): what a
Run holds. What the run detects is recorded on the Run, never written back (P-23).

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content_digest` | no | [ContentDigest](value-objects.md#contentdigest) or `null` | `null` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` (pattern `^agt_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`) |  |  |
| `version` | yes | `integer` (minimum 1) |  |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

## AppliesWhenCondition

Embedded in: [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md), [PricingCatalog](PricingCatalog.md), [RunBundle](RunBundle.md)

### Description

One typed condition of a price entry (P-37). A condition is something the resolver can
evaluate from the caller's ``PriceFacts`` or knows it cannot (``ambiguous_price``).

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | yes | one of `"context_tokens_gt"`, `"context_tokens_le"`, `"batch"`, `"region"` |  |  |
| `value` | yes | `integer` (minimum 0; maximum 2**53 - 1) or `boolean` or `string` (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]{0,255}$`) |  |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

### Conditional rules

The schema states these conditional rules as `allOf` of `if`/`then` (copied verbatim from the schema file).

```json
[
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "enum": [
            "context_tokens_gt",
            "context_tokens_le"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "kind"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "enum": [
            "batch"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "kind"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "enum": [
            "region"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "kind"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      }
    }
  }
]
```

## BillingRules

Embedded in: [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md), [PricingCatalog](PricingCatalog.md), [RunBundle](RunBundle.md)

### Description

How a provider bills one event (ADR 0014 Decision 11, P-38): both parts are required and
each is a value or the literal ``"none"``. ``increment``: a positive decimal quantity in the
entry's unit (the quantity is rounded up to a multiple of it). ``minimum``: a USD ``Money``
>= 0, the minimum charge per billable event.

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `increment` | yes | one of `"none"` or `string` (pattern `^(?:[1-9][0-9]*\|[1-9][0-9]*\.[0-9]{0,17}[1-9]\|0\.[0-9]{0,17}[1-9])$`) |  |  |
| `minimum` | yes | one of `"none"` or [Money](value-objects.md#money) |  |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

## ChannelMap

Embedded in: [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md), [Run](Run.md), [RunBundle](RunBundle.md)

### Description

Which channel of an artifact carries whom (ADR 0012 Decision 5).

``declared``: the producer's documented layout (for example Pipecat's stereo buffer, left the
caller and right the agent); ``method`` names the declaration and there is no confidence (a
declaration is not a probability). ``inferred``: our analysis; ``method`` names it and
``confidence`` is required. At most one channel is the agent (a second AI agent is a separate
run), indexes are unique and the order is kept.

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact_id` | yes | `string` (pattern `^art_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`) |  |  |
| `channels` | yes | array of [ChannelAssignment](value-objects.md#channelassignment) (at least 1 items) |  |  |
| `confidence` | no | `number` (minimum 0; maximum 1) or `null` | `null` |  |
| `determination` | yes | one of `"declared"`, `"inferred"` |  |  |
| `method` | yes | `string` (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]{0,255}$`) |  |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

### Conditional rules

The schema states these conditional rules as `allOf` of `if`/`then` (copied verbatim from the schema file).

```json
[
  {
    "else": {
      "properties": {
        "confidence": {
          "type": "null"
        }
      }
    },
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "determination": {
          "enum": [
            "inferred"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "determination"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "confidence": {
          "type": "number"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "confidence"
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

## CostExclusion

Embedded in: [CostSummary](CostSummary.md), [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md), [RunBundle](RunBundle.md)

### Description

A record a summary leaves out of its total, and why (Decision 16a): the record's
``na_reason``, ``duplicate_of_reported`` (an available computed record set aside for an
available reported one; ``covered_by`` non-empty) or ``overlaps_reported`` (an available
computed record that only partly overlaps included reported records, N53). ``covered_by``
lists the included records that cover all of the record's usage, else it is empty; it names
each record at most once (N78).

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `covered_by` | yes | array of `string` (pattern `^cst_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`) (no repeated items (`uniqueItems`)) |  |  |
| `reason` | yes | one of `"no_price_for_model"`, `"unit_unpriced"`, `"no_usage"`, `"ambiguous_price"`, `"billing_rules_missing"`, `"usage_not_reported"`, `"unsupported_currency"`, `"currency_not_reported"`, `"amount_unparseable"`, `"currency_conflict"`, `"duplicate_of_reported"`, `"overlaps_reported"` |  |  |
| `ref` | yes | `string` (pattern `^cst_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`) |  |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

### Conditional rules

The schema states these conditional rules as `allOf` of `if`/`then` (copied verbatim from the schema file).

```json
[
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "reason": {
          "enum": [
            "duplicate_of_reported"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "reason"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "covered_by": {
          "minItems": 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
]
```

## LanguageDeclaration

Embedded in: [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md), [RunBundle](RunBundle.md), [Transcript](Transcript.md)

### Description

A user's declaration of the language of an untagged import (N14, ADR 0004 Decision 6g).

Never an observation: it fills no observed field, script-sensitive metrics never use it, and
every result that uses it says so (``language_source=declared``).

``language``, ``source`` and ``declared_at`` are required. ``declared_by`` (who declared it, a
machine key without ``@``) is optional (N19, ADR 0004 Decision 6g): ``None`` (absent and
``null`` are the same) says nothing about the declarer, and a present value is validated as
before. A shared or benchmark ``ExportBundle`` holds no ``declared_by`` (``[declared_by]``,
``bundle.check_export_bundle``); an internal export, a bare ``RunBundle`` and a bare
``Transcript`` may keep it.

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `declared_at` | yes | `string` (pattern of 129 characters (see the schema file); format `date-time`) |  |  |
| `declared_by` | no | `string` (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/+-]{0,255}$`) or `null` | `null` |  |
| `language` | yes | `string` (pattern of 122 characters (see the schema file)) |  |  |
| `source` | yes | one of `"user_declared"` |  |  |

## PriceEntry

Embedded in: [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md), [PricingCatalog](PricingCatalog.md), [RunBundle](RunBundle.md)

### Description

One price of a catalog version (ADR 0014 Decision 11; a value object since revision 15).

The entry lives inside its catalog version (N47) and is named by the author-assigned
``entry_key``, unique within that version (N61). ``price`` and the billing ``minimum`` are USD
money >= 0 (P-38); ``unit_quantity`` and the billing ``increment`` are positive canonical
decimals. ``billing`` is the literal ``"unknown"`` or billing rules whose two parts are each a
value or the literal ``"none"``. ``aliases`` are distinct and never the entry's own ``model``
(N72). ``applies_when`` is absent or a non-empty list of conditions of distinct kinds that must
all hold (N49). The effective range is half-open, ``[effective_from, effective_to)``.
``price_source`` says whether the price comes from the catalog or from the user, and a
``user_supplied`` price needs ``provenance.note``.

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aliases` | no | array of `string` (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]{0,255}$`) (no repeated items (`uniqueItems`)) |  |  |
| `applies_when` | no | array of [AppliesWhenCondition](value-objects.md#applieswhencondition) (at least 1 items) or `null` | `null` |  |
| `billing` | yes | one of `"unknown"` or [BillingRules](value-objects.md#billingrules) |  |  |
| `effective_from` | yes | `string` (pattern of 129 characters (see the schema file); format `date-time`) |  |  |
| `effective_to` | no | `string` (pattern of 129 characters (see the schema file); format `date-time`) or `null` | `null` |  |
| `entry_key` | yes | `string` (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]{0,255}$`) |  |  |
| `model` | yes | `string` (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]{0,255}$`) |  |  |
| `price` | yes | [Money](value-objects.md#money) |  |  |
| `price_source` | yes | one of `"catalog"`, `"user_supplied"` |  |  |
| `provenance` | yes | [PriceProvenance](value-objects.md#priceprovenance) |  |  |
| `provider` | yes | `string` (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]{0,255}$`) |  |  |
| `unit` | yes | one of `"input_tokens"`, `"cache_read_input_tokens"`, `"cache_write_input_tokens"`, `"output_tokens"`, `"audio_input_seconds"`, `"audio_output_seconds"`, `"input_characters"`, `"requests"` |  |  |
| `unit_quantity` | yes | `string` (pattern `^(?:[1-9][0-9]*\|[1-9][0-9]*\.[0-9]{0,17}[1-9]\|0\.[0-9]{0,17}[1-9])$`) |  |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

### Conditional rules

The schema states these conditional rules as `allOf` of `if`/`then` (copied verbatim from the schema file).

```json
[
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "price_source": {
          "enum": [
            "user_supplied"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "price_source"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "provenance": {
          "properties": {
            "note": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "note"
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  }
]
```

## PrivacyMarker

Embedded in: [Artifact](Artifact.md), [DatasetItem](DatasetItem.md), [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md), [Run](Run.md), [RunBundle](RunBundle.md), [Transcript](Transcript.md)

### Description

Whether a payload is human-subject data, with its consent and retention (ADR 0016).

Consent and retention are present if and only if ``human_subject`` is true (P-46): a consent
record for a synthetic voice would read as a consent gap. ``human_subject_reason`` records why
a marker is stricter than the derivation (P-47) and is rejected on a false marker.

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `consent` | no | [ConsentRecord](value-objects.md#consentrecord) or `null` | `null` |  |
| `human_subject` | yes | `boolean` |  |  |
| `human_subject_reason` | no | one of `"marked_before_role_evidence"`, `"real_person_likeness"`, `"manual"` or `null` | `null` |  |
| `retention` | no | [RetentionPolicy](value-objects.md#retentionpolicy) or `null` | `null` |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

### Conditional rules

The schema states these conditional rules as `allOf` of `if`/`then` (copied verbatim from the schema file).

```json
[
  {
    "else": {
      "properties": {
        "consent": {
          "type": "null"
        },
        "human_subject_reason": {
          "type": "null"
        },
        "retention": {
          "type": "null"
        }
      }
    },
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "human_subject": {
          "enum": [
            true
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "human_subject"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "consent": {
          "type": "object"
        },
        "retention": {
          "type": "object"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "consent",
        "retention"
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

### Description

## SealedAadFields

Embedded in: [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md)

### Description

The additional authenticated data of a sealed payload (ADR 0015 Decision 4).

Decryption under any other ``payload_type``, ``subject_id``, ``subject_version`` or
``schema_version`` fails authentication. ``schema_version`` is the plaintext's version and is
not compared with the package's version (S-N79): a migrated bundle does not rewrite it.

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `payload_type` | yes | one of `"test_profile"`, `"audio"`, `"transcript_text"`, `"tool_arguments"`, `"tool_result"` |  |  |
| `schema_version` | yes | `string` (pattern `^(?:0\|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(?:0\|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(?:0\|[1-9][0-9]*)$`) |  |  |
| `subject_id` | yes | `string` (pattern `^(?:tpf\|art\|tsc\|tcl)_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`) |  |  |
| `subject_version` | no | `integer` (minimum 1) or `null` | `null` |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

### Conditional rules

The schema states these conditional rules as `allOf` of `if`/`then` (copied verbatim from the schema file).

```json
[
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "payload_type": {
          "enum": [
            "test_profile"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "payload_type"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "subject_id": {
          "pattern": "^tpf_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
        },
        "subject_version": {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "subject_version"
      ]
    }
  },
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "payload_type": {
          "enum": [
            "audio"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "payload_type"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "subject_id": {
          "pattern": "^art_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
        },
        "subject_version": {
          "type": "null"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "payload_type": {
          "enum": [
            "transcript_text"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "payload_type"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "subject_id": {
          "pattern": "^tsc_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
        },
        "subject_version": {
          "type": "null"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "payload_type": {
          "enum": [
            "tool_arguments"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "payload_type"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "subject_id": {
          "pattern": "^tcl_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
        },
        "subject_version": {
          "type": "null"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "payload_type": {
          "enum": [
            "tool_result"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "payload_type"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "subject_id": {
          "pattern": "^tcl_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
        },
        "subject_version": {
          "type": "null"
        }
      }
    }
  }
]
```

## SealedPayload

Embedded in: [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md)

### Description

An encrypted payload bound to its subject (ADR 0015 Decision 1). Only an ``ExportBundle``
may carry one (Decision 7, P1-14); snapshots, runs and internal bundles never do.

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aad_fields` | yes | [SealedAadFields](value-objects.md#sealedaadfields) |  |  |
| `alg` | yes | one of `"A256GCM"` |  |  |
| `ciphertext` | yes | `string` (pattern `^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9_-][AQgw]\|[A-Za-z0-9_-]{2}[AEIMQUYcgkosw048])?$`; at least 22 characters) |  |  |
| `dek_wrap` | yes | [DekWrap](value-objects.md#dekwrap) |  |  |
| `format` | yes | one of `"tracer.sealed.v1"` |  |  |
| `nonce` | yes | `string` (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16}$`) |  |  |
| `plaintext_digest` | no | [ContentDigest](value-objects.md#contentdigest) or `null` | `null` |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

### Conditional rules

The schema states these conditional rules as `allOf` of `if`/`then` (copied verbatim from the schema file).

```json
[
  {
    "properties": {
      "plaintext_digest": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "null"
          },
          {
            "properties": {
              "scheme": {
                "enum": [
                  "hmac-sha256-jcs/v1"
                ]
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "key_ref",
              "scheme"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
]
```

## UsageQuantity

Embedded in: [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md), [RunBundle](RunBundle.md), [UsageRecord](UsageRecord.md)

### Description

One usage bucket of a billable call (ADR 0014 Decision 9).

``unit`` is one of eight disjoint buckets (``input_tokens`` is uncached input). For the token,
character and request units ``count`` is a strict integer >= 0; for the two audio-seconds
units (``audio_input_seconds``, ``audio_output_seconds``) it is a canonical decimal string
>= 0 (a JSON number is rejected, so seconds are never a float). Zero is known usage of nothing
(N45 (b)); no quantity is negative (N45 (a)).

### Fields

| Field | Required | Type and constraints | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | yes | `integer` (minimum 0; maximum 2**53 - 1) or `string` (pattern `^(?:0\|-?[1-9][0-9]*\|-?(?:0\|[1-9][0-9]*)\.[0-9]{0,17}[1-9])$`) |  |  |
| `unit` | yes | one of `"input_tokens"`, `"cache_read_input_tokens"`, `"cache_write_input_tokens"`, `"output_tokens"`, `"audio_input_seconds"`, `"audio_output_seconds"`, `"input_characters"`, `"requests"` |  |  |

Members not listed above are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

### Conditional rules

The schema states these conditional rules as `allOf` of `if`/`then` (copied verbatim from the schema file).

```json
[
  {
    "else": {
      "properties": {
        "count": {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      }
    },
    "if": {
      "properties": {
        "unit": {
          "enum": [
            "audio_input_seconds",
            "audio_output_seconds"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "unit"
      ]
    },
    "then": {
      "properties": {
        "count": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      }
    }
  }
]
```
